verdict.rationale: Databricks documents an official, versioned CLI for working with the platform from a local terminal or automation scripts (0.205+, with a migration path from 0.18). It is used across Unity Catalog objects, shown in API reference examples, and extended by a GPU-training CLI, and a probe confirms the CLI docs page exists. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-native or agent-oriented CLI ergonomics (e.g. structured/JSON output for agents), independent or hands-on corroboration.
